title: Filipino-Style Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Filipino stew made with tender beef and vegetables.
instructions: Heat the ultra in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the milk, stew, filipino, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with additional salt and filipino if desired.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
